negative_history: model-free instrument ceiling: no equal-budget policy can reach the frozen 0.05 material-effect gate in that instrument
question: Can ORION faithfully consume the strongest model/scalar parent learner-value ordering while adding only checkpoint-bound provenance and noncompensatory structural safety constraints, without weakening the parent, tuning on outcome results, or granting training/scientific authority?

strongest_parent_semantics.source: C_STRONGEST_MODEL_AWARE_PARENT in the already-frozen five-arm Paper-IV Phase-2 protocol
strongest_parent_semantics.input_contract: opaque per-candidate scalar learner-value scores produced outside this module under a frozen provider identity; higher is better
strongest_parent_semantics.fidelity_rule: when all candidates are structurally admissible, the assimilated selector must reproduce the strongest-parent ordering exactly except deterministic candidate-id tie-breaking on equal scores
forbidden: using Paper-IV confirmatory outcomes to alter parent scores or thresholds
replacing parent scores with RAKL utility scalarization
using scientific-authority state as a compensating score
silent candidate dropping or score imputation

allowed_additions: provider identity and score-bundle content hash

tests_frozen_before_implementation: SAFE_PARENT_FIDELITY: safe candidates are selected in exact descending parent-score order
STRUCTURAL_VETO: highest-score candidate with forgetting or negative-transfer risk above the frozen bound is rejected and cannot be compensated by its parent score
LEAK_VETO: confirmatory-target-leak candidate is rejected regardless of parent score
STALE_CHECKPOINT: parent score bundle bound to a different model checkpoint returns CANNOT_CHECK
COVERAGE_FAIL_CLOSED: missing/extra/duplicate candidate score identity returns CANNOT_CHECK
TAMPER_FAIL_CLOSED: score-bundle content hash mismatch returns INVALID
AUTHORITY_INERT: every decision grants neither scientific authority nor training-policy activation
ACTIVE_DEFAULT_UNCHANGED: this successor never mutates STATIC_STRUCTURAL authority

promotion_boundary: A green development gate promotes only the strongest-parent assimilation mechanic as a proposal-only/conformance surface. It does not show Adaptive/assimilated ORION beats Static or the strongest parent, does not activate it as the training default, and does not authorize standalone Paper IV. The already-frozen exact 7B five-arm Phase-2 experiment remains the sovereign efficacy test.
fresh_assurance_after_development: Before any future active-policy promotion, repeat the conformance gate on the exact harvested Phase-2 subject/score provider identity and then require the existing Phase-2 efficacy, hard-harm, cost, fresh-family and multi-checkpoint gates.
